feedback: Test case R006-T02 is invalid because it involves operators with different precedence (addition and multiplication), so it does not test left-to-right evaluation of equal-precedence operators. The requirement specifically states that operators of equal precedence should be evaluated from left to right. Therefore, this test case is not valid and must be removed. Test case R006-T03 is valid as it tests left-to-right evaluation for addition operators of equal precedence. Test case R006-T01 is valid as it tests left-to-right evaluation for subtraction operators of equal precedence. The revised test set should only include R006-T01 and R006-T03. The current test plan includes an invalid test case that misrepresents the requirement.
